candidates.title: ForkKV: Scaling Multi-LoRA Agent Serving via Copy-on-Write Disaggregated KV Cache
candidates.reason: Multi-LoRA agent serving system applying OS-style copy-on-write semantics to shared versus adapter-specific KV state, with a DualRadixTree and SRAM reconstruction kernel; reports up to 3.0x throughput over multi-LoRA serving baselines.

candidates.title: Efficient Multi-Adapter LLM Serving via Cross-Model KV-Cache Reuse with Activated LoRA
candidates.reason: vLLM-based serving engine enabling cross-model prefix-cache reuse between base and adapted models through Activated LoRA, base-aligned block hashing and activation-aware masking; reports up to 58x end-to-end latency reduction and >100x TTFT improvement versus standard LoRA baselines.

discovery_stats.axis: multi-LoRA/adapter co-serving・cross-model KV reuse・agent workflow cache sharing
discovery_stats.query_summary: collective/network軸からmulti-model/LoRA co-servingへ切り替え、2025-2026のadapter cache・multi-agent shared contextを探索した。Punicaは既知基礎系統、SwiftCacheは既知候補として除外し、ForkKVとActivated-LoRA servingをdefault branchのcanonical ID/title検索で未収録確認した。
